note: Exact-layer-index overlap after normalized-depth mapping is modest (4/10 at k=10) -- layer 27 in 135M does NOT directly correspond to layer 27 in 360M by architecture, and even the depth-based mapping only partially aligns. However, at a COARSER granularity (quintile depth-region: which fifth of the network the most-sensitive layers fall in), both models concentrate their most-sensitive layers in the mid-to-late region (quintiles 2-4 of 5), avoiding the earliest layers -- a real, if coarse, cross-model regularity. Both models also share one striking finding: their single MOST sensitive layer sits very near (but not at) the end of the network (135M layer 19 then 27; 360M layer 30 of 32) -- not the literal final layer, and not early/middle layers either.
